label: Guidance table, by computation
description: A placed diagnostic for d1fb6414. Counterfactual guidance by an outweighed reason, with the reason itself raised alone, separates good-tracking favouring from favouring blind to that respect and from favouring fixed to one content, and it is a property of the profile and the value structure: profiles tracking the same feature receive the same verdicts (guidanceLabelIndependent). The personal source and the imitability-exemplar rival share the good-tracking profile, so the test gives them the same verdict; since the rival is defined as a structural duplicate of the personal source, that parity follows from its definition. The table also exhibits the second-order standard used for strong self-application, which is scenario-invariant and so supports no value-dependence at second order for either side (secondOrderStandardNotDependedOn). Establishes no premise.
